newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian CPI in June 1.4 pct -Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Italian CPI in June 1.4 pct -Prodi.

text.p: Italian inflation in June will come in at 1.4 percent year-on-year, Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Monday, adding that the inflation rate would rise by year end but would still be below two percent.
Preliminary price data pointed to inflation in June of 1.4-1.5 percent year-on-year. Full June data will be released on Friday.
"Inflation this month is at 1.4 percent. By the end of the year it will be a bit higher but certainly less than two percent," Prodi told an industrialists' convention.
"It is certainly a great success not bringing the economy to its knees," Prodi added.
The government's average inflation target for 1997 is 2.5 percent but ministers say the final figure should be well below that. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
